items.name: Hôtel Alizéa
items.description:
Located a 20-minute walk from La Rochelle Old Harbour and 1 km from the sea, and 500m from the Rugby Stade Rochelais Marcel Deflandre.

The 5 hotel rooms share 2 toilets and 2 showers. Each room has a sink area, TV and free WiFi.
The apartment has a private bathroom, and also a TV and free WiFi.

La réception de l’hôtel est ouverte du lundi au vendredi de 7h30 à 14h. En dehors de ces horaires, l’accès à l’hôtel se fait de manière autonome via un système de boites à clés.

The hotel restaurant Mezcla, is open continuously from 7:30 AM to 2:00 PM, from Monday to Friday and on public holidays. Breakfast is served from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM from Monday to Friday and from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM on weekends. Please remember to make reservations at least the day before.
The restaurant offers a fusion of Mediterranean and South American cuisine.
